name: Imouto Pet ~Repure~
source: You've been asked to take care of your younger sisters who haven't seen you in years. When you arrive at the home of your mother they're waiting for you in the living room wearing nothing but ribbons! Dressed as sweet little presents for you to unwrap they beg you 'Please onii-chan, make us your pets!'
translation: You've been asked to take care of your younger sisters who haven't seen you in years. When you arrive at the home of your mother they're waiting for you in the living room wearing nothing but ribbons!
